name: She-Hulk

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.

howToPlay: She-Hulk için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Citing Precedent
Tireless research grants a benefit based on the opponent's Class.
Mystic: +[1,642.5 - 6,022.54] Attack Rating and She-Hulk's attacks cause the opponent to gain 25% less Power.
Science: [30 - 70]% chance with each hit landed to Purify a Debuff.
Cosmic: +[766.5 - 1,861.52] Attack Rating for each Buff the opponent has.
Tech: Opponent suffers -[15 - 60]% Armor Up effect duration & Potency.
Mutant: Opponent suffers -[20 - 55]% Ability Accuracy during Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Induce Panic
content: She-Hulk's sharp intellect and overwhelming strength panics her foes, increasing their chance to launch a Special Attack by 15% for each of her personal Passive Fury effects.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: An enhanced immune system provides full Immunity to Poison.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked & When Attacking
content: 11% chance to gain a Passive Fury effect, increasing attack by [3,832.5] for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Opponent activates a Special Attack
content: When a non-Skill Opponent activates a Special Attack, She-Hulk refreshes all personal Fury Passives.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If the opponent is Unstoppable, this attack cannot be interrupted. If the attack lands, the Unstoppable effect is removed and She-Hulk gains a Passive Fury, increasing attack by [7,665] for 8 seconds.
Causes a Slow Debuff on the opponent for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Extensive weight training allows She-Hulk's personal Passive Fury effects and all Stun Debuffs to last up to 50% longer, based on the size of her opponent. Larger opponents grant longer effects.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to gain a Passive Fury effect, increasing attack by [3,832.5] for 8 seconds.
75% chance to Exhaust the opponent, reducing Critical Damage Rating by [114.58] for 10 seconds. The Opponent's Power Gain effects are also reduced by 25% for each Exhaustion Debuff on them.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict a Petrify Debuff of 115% Potency for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict Weakness, decreasing the target's Attack by 65% for 14 seconds.
